#080 · Hermit Crab Pokémon

Slowbro

Water Psychic

Kanto · Generation 1

Slowbro is a Water/Psychic-type Hermit Crab Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 78.5 kg. It evolves from Slowpoke. Its highest base stat is Defense (110), with a base stat total of 490.
